mat(color) = psxMaterial({color, vertexColors: true, lit: false, unique: true}) (viewmodel.ts:61). shaded(geometry, floor=0.58) bakes per-vertex directional shade using LIGHT (0.35,0.85,0.4) (46-58). boxG/cylG wrap it (59-60). Any new mesh needs these wrappers, otherwise vertexColors:true reads no colour attribute.

extensionPoints: viewmodel.ts:78 GLOVE constant is read in exactly two places: Hand field init at 87 and Hand.refresh at 140. Making it per-instance (a field plus a setGlove(c) beside setSleeve at 137) is the minimal route for dark leather. ViewmodelHost gets a setGloveColor next to setSleeveColor (381).

viewmodel.ts:98-100 is the only cuff geometry (forearm sleeve box). A glove cuff ring is inserted right after line 100 and before the finger loop (101). Use boxG(...) and this.glove, tilted rotation.x=0.1 like the forearm. Estimated front-edge position of the forearm is about (0, +0.013, +0.031) (computed from the rotation of the box at z=0.2), so verify in-engine. A single collar box is 12 tris (about 156 per hand, within ART 8.5's ~150). A four-bar frame is 48 tris (about 192), which overshoots the spec.

Texture hook on the glove: setPorcelainMap (viewmodel.ts:377-380) and Hand.setPorcelain (131-136) set glove.map directly. No caller passes a map today. Leather grain could use the same path, but the texture must go through psxTexture (psxMaterial.ts:271-280) first, because direct map assignment skips the build() path at psxMaterial.ts:305.

Add a flag(c, 'gloves', ...) row beside calm (settingsScreen.ts:199), with strings EN (settingsScreen.strings.ts:56-57) and TR (127-128). Listen to 'settings:changed' (events.ts:55) to apply live, as ui.ts:1011 does. The only per-player look is profile.color, picked at random on first save (save.ts:53, 88), loaded (save.ts:103), and read in local.ts:151. No setter exists in src.

The settings.viewmodel flag is persisted and used (settings.ts:14, 48; local.ts:154, 322, 355, 368, 388, 426) but has NO settings UI row (settingsScreen.ts rows 106-212; no 'viewmodel' key in settingsScreen.strings.ts). Players cannot turn hands off today.

Hands dim with light: refresh multiplies by lightLevel 0.2..1 (viewmodel.ts:138, 382; driven at local.ts:535 as 0.35+0.65*light). With the vertex shade floor 0.58 (viewmodel.ts:49), very dark leather such as P25 #311910 falls to roughly (10,5,3) in dim rooms and vanishes. Prefer P13/P16-range leather or a lighter cuff ring.

PSX output: the viewmodel overlay is drawn after clearDepth (psxRenderer.ts:232-241), then the whole frame goes through 4x4 Bayer dither and 15-bit quantize (psxRenderer.ts:245-249; ART_BIBLE.md §1.5 at 156-175). Very dark gradients will band or dither. Stay on master-palette hexes (ART §2.1 pre-snapped to 15-bit, ART_BIBLE.md:19).

Changing GLOVE from P09 IVORY changes a documented palette role. ART_BIBLE.md:418 lists P09 as 'default UI text, card faces, gloves', and §8.5 (2309) says the sleeve follows the jacket colour. Mannequin and dealer hands stay P09 (ART_BIBLE.md:1161), so a glove change should be scoped to the viewmodel only.

Visibility is gated by phase: hidden in seated/machine, cinematic start (local.ts:299, 365) and cutscene (422). The death cutscene will therefore hide gloves unless the cutscene ends first. Shown only in phase 'free' (368, 388, 426).
Coin tricks run only when item==='coin' and walk mode (viewmodel.ts:418; fidget.ts:222-226). Holding a phone or ticket at Home stops the Q tricks by design.

suggestion:
Minimal path for leather gloves with a cuff ring, respecting PSX conventions:

1. viewmodel.ts: replace the GLOVE read (line 87 init, line 140 refresh) with a per-hand field. Add Hand.setGlove(c) next to setSleeve (137), and ViewmodelHost.setGloveColor next to setSleeveColor (381). Pick a leather hex from the master palette: P13 CASINO_RED 0x8C1921 is already tagged 'leather' (ART_BIBLE.md:422), P16 RUST_DEEP 0x4A2110 (425) or P12 OXBLOOD 0x5A1019 (421) for a darker read. Avoid anything darker than about P16, because of the light-dimming issue above.
2. viewmodel.ts: after line 100, add one collar box: boxG(0.09, 0.078, 0.014) with this.glove, rotation.x=0.1, centre about (0, 0.013, 0.031). This is 12 tris per hand, within the ~150 budget. Verify the seam in-engine.
3. local.ts: at lines 151-154, the sleeve stays jacket colour. Apply the glove colour from settings after creation, or via a new optional createViewmodel parameter. Keep the porcelain collateral (local.ts:398) overriding to bone, as it does now.
4. settings.ts (14, 48) plus settingsScreen.ts (flag row near 199) plus settingsScreen.strings.ts (EN 56-57, TR 127-128): add a gloves toggle with live apply through settings:changed (events.ts:55). Optionally also expose a Home-state look via a new optional Viewmodel method (types.ts:23-31), keeping bench.ts:42 compiling.
5. Do not add a cosmetic or shop system unless the director asks. None exists, and the current slot for the look is the viewmodel only."]
